problem_statement: A device whose driver API embeds another (parent) driver API as its first member should be recognisable as belonging to the parent API class. DEVICE_API_IS(parent_class, dev) must return true for a device whose API is a child class that extends the parent, and DEVICE_API_GET/DEVICE_API_IS must work correctly for multi-level inheritance (grandchild extends child extends parent) and for sibling relationships (two child classes extending the same parent must be distinguished, and a sibling must not be recognised as the other child). Before this capability a child-class device is not seen as a member of the parent class, so a device using an extended API cannot be used wherever the base API is expected.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T tests/kernel/device -s tests/kernel/device/kernel.device -s kernel.device -O twister-out --no-clean -W
